description: Run a non-mutating export readiness audit for an active or named sequence. It reports blocking offline media, empty timelines, inaccessible preset/output paths, duration, and optional timeline gaps without queuing an export.

check_gaps.description: Report gaps on populated tracks as warnings (defaults to true).

output_path.description: Optional intended delivery path; its parent folder is checked.

require_non_empty_timeline.description: Treat an empty sequence as a blocking error (defaults to true).

sequence_id.description: Sequence ID or name. Defaults to the active sequence.

name: validate_project_for_export

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Validate Project For Export
